lean.statement: For every finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, every function V:E→ℝ, and every real m, if 0<m, V is genuinely Fréchet differentiable on E, and V is m-strongly convex on Set.univ, then there exists p:E such that IsMinOn V Set.univ p and gradient V p=0.
approved_definition_context: StrongConvexOn Set.univ m V is Mathlib's whole-space strong-convexity predicate with real modulus m.
IsMinOn V Set.univ p means V(p)≤V(x) for every x in E.
gradient is the real inner-product gradient. Differentiable ℝ V is a genuine regularity hypothesis, so the gradient is not being inferred from a totalized derivative value.
